title: Crystal Dagger with Tentacles
description: A dark purple crystalline dagger floats diagonally against a deep purple background. The blade is fractured at the top with exploding purple crystal shards, while the hilt features ornate golden bands with turquoise gems and golden tendrils wrapping around it.
prompt: A highly detailed dark purple crystalline dagger floating diagonally, its fractured blade exploding with sharp purple crystal shards at the top. The ornate golden hilt has turquoise gems and is wrapped with glowing golden tendrils. Several translucent purple tentacled orbs with glowing eyes and crackled surfaces cling to the blade, emitting a mystical blue and purple aura, set against a deep purple gradient background with dramatic lighting and soft shadows.
